citations.quote: result clarifies the central role of copulas in threshold models

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: In a threshold credit model default occurs when a latent critical variable falls below a threshold; joint default depends only on the copula of the critical variables, so CreditMetrics and KMV/Merton are exactly Gaussian threshold models with a Gauss copula, per McNeil et al. (2015) Ch.11 §11.1.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Threshold (Latent-Variable) Credit Models and Their Copula Structure
